summary: Proposed data centre-led technology and energy campus on around 55 hectares of Nuclear Decommissioning Authority-owned unlicensed land north of the former Chapelcross nuclear power station near Annan. PAN 26/0855/PAN describes up to about 162,000 sqm of data-centre buildings plus a training/reception/security centre, industrial units, substation and infrastructure. CX Power describes a potential 1 GW campus, but does not define whether that is IT load or grid import. Pre-application consultation ran in May-June 2026 and a planning-permission-in-principle application is targeted for December 2026, with phased construction claimed for 2027-2035. A local opposition campaign launched in August 2026.
maturity_explanation: Early development: PAN 26/0855/PAN is now identified through a mirror of the Dumfries and Galloway planning record, and community consultation took place in May and June 2026. The developer says an EIA scoping report was submitted in March, but its official reference remains unverified. No full planning application has yet been validated.
anticipated_construction_start: 2027 (developer-stated phased delivery 2027-2035; SSG material reportedly refers to potential site commencement in 2027)
anticipated_operational_date: 2030 (press-reported 'could be operational by 2030' if consents proceed)

phases.description: Developer states phased delivery of the campus from 2027 to 2035; phase composition not published.

latest_development.headline: Local campaign Say NO to the Chapelcross AI Data Centre launched a petition opposing the proposed hyperscale campus
